title: Adorable Dog Ornaments | Christmas Tree
short_description:
[cg_accordion title='Core Features']
  • Material: Crafted from two layers of poplar plywood, ensuring durability and a natural aesthetic.
  • Customization Options: Personalize the top layer with your dog's breed, name, and choose from various icon options or a larger dog image.
  • Dimensions: Each ornament measures 100mm x 100mm with an added 10mm ring for hanging. The layers are 2 layers of 3mm poplar plywood.
  • Angel Wings Option: For a heavenly touch, add angel wings to your dog's ornament.
  • Breed Variety: Choose from over 150 dog breeds and variations.
[/cg_accordion][cg_accordion title='Details']Our handcrafted dog Christmas tree ornaments are a unique and personalized way to celebrate your furry friend during the holiday season. The double-layered poplar wood base can be stained in various colors, while the top layer offers a range of customization options, including icon rings with dog-related images or a larger dog image. Each ornament is meticulously crafted with precision and attention to detail, ensuring a high-quality and durable product.[/cg_accordion][cg_accordion title='Delivery & Returns']
  • Production Time: Please allow 5-10 days for production, as each ornament is custom-made.
  • Shipping: Once completed, your ornament will be shipped via Royal Mail 48h tracked service.
  • Returns: Due to the custom nature of these products, we unfortunately cannot accept returns unless the ornament is damaged upon delivery.
[/cg_accordion]
meta_description: Celebrate your dog with a handcrafted layered wooden ornament. Customize with breed, name, angel wings, and more.
